stem.text: The ${}^{68}\text{Ge}$ isotope is medically useful because it undergoes a natural radioactive process to give an isotope of a different element, ${}^{68}\text{X}$, which can be used to detect tumours. This transformation of ${}^{68}\text{Ge}$ occurs when an electron enters the nucleus and changes a proton into a neutron.
Which statement about the composition of an atom of ${}^{68}\text{X}$ is correct?

A.text: It has 4 electrons in its outer p orbitals.

B.text: It has 13 electrons in its outer shell.
